"Casino 7s" is new from the Texas Lottery. It is a $5 game with four top prizes of $100,000. Nothing big has been won yet because almost no one has played it. This page will show it when that changes.

Everything here about "Casino 7s" comes from official Texas lottery numbers, current through October 24.
2775.headline: New in stores

2776.body:
"Patriotic Payout" just went on sale in Texas. The game has ten full prize levels with eight top prizes of $30,000. Every scratcher starts this way and loses prizes as it sells. You are seeing this one before that starts, when it is easiest to judge.

Today's free summary of "Patriotic Payout" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
